piper.name: Piper
piper.about: Small, quick voices (VITS) — several times faster than real time on any processor.

kokoro.name: Kokoro
kokoro.about: A small, highly rated neural model with hexgrad's own reading of English (every word spoken) — about four times faster than real time on a processor.

parler.name: Parler-TTS
parler.about: Large models that speak as a sentence describes (a named speaker, a pace, very clear audio). Slow on a processor — a graphics card helps a lot.

xtts.name: XTTS-v2
xtts.licence: Coqui Public Model License (non-commercial use only)
xtts.about: Coqui's large multilingual model: 58 studio voices, and voices taken from short recordings. About real time on a fast processor.

supertonic.name: Supertonic
supertonic.about: Supertone's small ONNX models — three to eight times faster than real time on a processor.

melo.name: MeloTTS
melo.about: MyShell's MeloTTS: one model with American, British, Indian and Australian accents (women's voices), run by sherpa-onnx — about three times faster than real time on a processor.

indictiny.name: Indic Tiny TTS
indictiny.licence: MIT (the program); the model CC BY 4.0
indictiny.about: A tiny Indian English model (22.5 million parameters) trained on IISc’s SYSPIN recordings, with its own Indian reading of numbers, ₹, lakh and crore — about seven times faster than real time on one processor core.

qwen.name: Qwen3-TTS
qwen.about: Alibaba's speech language models: nine named speakers, and a model that speaks in a voice described in words. About four times slower than real time on a processor (0.6B); a graphics card is many times faster.

omnivoice.name: OmniVoice
omnivoice.licence: Apache-2.0 (the program); the model CC BY-NC
omnivoice.about: k2-fsa's (Xiaomi) model that makes a voice from a few words — sex, age, pitch and an accent (Indian, American, British, Australian, Canadian …).

bark.name: Bark
bark.about: Suno's expressive GPT-style model, speaking in the manner of a voice preset — English speakers and Hindi speakers (English with an Indian accent). Slow on a processor; its pace cannot be set.

chatterbox.name: Chatterbox
chatterbox.about: Resemble AI's expressive models: their own voice, or a voice taken from a 10-second recording. The program marks the speech with an inaudible watermark and runs on its own PyTorch 2.6 (a second copy).

veena.name: Veena
veena.about: Maya Research's 3-billion-parameter model trained on Indian voices. Made for a graphics card (about 7 GB of its memory); on a processor alone it is very slow.

voxcpm.name: VoxCPM2
voxcpm.about: OpenBMB's 2-billion-parameter model at 48 kHz: a voice described in words, or taken from a recording.

coqui.name: Coqui TTS (VITS)
coqui.about: IISc SYSPIN's Indian English voices, trained with Coqui TTS (VITS). Quick, but less clear than the newer models.

mms.name: MMS
mms.about: Meta's Massively Multilingual Speech: its small English voice (VITS).

pocket.name: Pocket TTS
pocket.about: Kyutai's small, natural model — faster than real time on a processor. Its speed cannot be changed.

indic-parler.name: Indic Parler-TTS (AI4Bharat)
indic-parler.untried: Not run here: Hugging Face gives it only to an account that has accepted its conditions.

parler-large.name: Parler-TTS Large v1
parler-large.untried: Not run here: 9.3 GB, more than the test machine had room for (the same program as Parler Mini, which was run).

qwen-1.7b.name: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B CustomVoice
qwen-1.7b.untried: Not run here: 4.5 GB (the same program as Qwen3-TTS 0.6B, which was run).

veena.name: Veena (Maya Research)
veena.untried: Not run here: 7.6 GB, made for a graphics card.

omnivoice.licence: CC BY-NC (the model; its audio tokenizer: Boson Higgs Audio 2 Community License)
omnivoice.name: OmniVoice (voices made from a few words)

chatterbox.name: Chatterbox (Resemble AI)
chatterbox.untried: Not run yet: it needs a second PyTorch (2.6) beside the model, more than the test machine had room for.

chatterbox-turbo.name: Chatterbox Turbo (Resemble AI)
chatterbox-turbo.untried: Not run yet: it needs a second PyTorch (2.6) beside the model, more than the test machine had room for.

xtts.licence: Coqui Public Model License — non-commercial use only
xtts.name: XTTS-v2 (Coqui)

pocket-clone.name: Pocket TTS with voice cloning (Kyutai)
pocket-clone.untried: Not run here: Hugging Face gives it only to an account that has accepted its conditions.

bark.name: Bark (Suno)
bark.untried: Not run here: 4.5 GB (the same program as Bark small).
